results.title: Circle the Block
results.overview: A man confronts his one-night stand after catching him in a white lie. Hookup culture's day of reckoning has come to pass.

results.title: Violet After the Storm
results.overview: In 1959 Violet Kingston, a mother of eight, contends with the loss of her husband in one of the worst fishing disasters in New Brunswick history.

results.title: Gush
results.overview: Elliot drags bestie Skylar along to her ex-girlfriend's Sálon. Seeking refuge from the boob-shaped discussion bowl in the bathroom; they get stuck in a tampon mishap stickier than the bad blood between old flames.

results.title: Tabungan Yang Dimakan Waktu
results.overview: A high school student realizes that her cash savings for college are damaged.

results.title: Sirkular
results.overview: When her mother falls ill, Putri becomes responsible of her mother's profession of clam-shucking. This role slowly takes Putri to repeat the same tragic cycle that her mother unfortunately experienced.

results.title: Satu Bungkus
results.overview: Having just recently transferred to a public school from a private one, Bella is still trying to blend in with her high school peers. After Bella's phone gets stolen, the four of them scours Glodok to hopefully find her phone back.

results.title: HYBE CHEERING PARTY
results.overview: The heat of cheering for HYBE artists unfolds in cinemas! Sing along with your favorite HYBE Artists in 3D! A one-of-a-kind game-like cheering screening is coming, where fans can chant fan cheers and wave their light sticks while watching the music videos of BTS, SEVENTEEN, TOMORROW X TOGETHER, ENHYPEN, LE SSERAFIM, &TEAM, BOYNEXTDOOR, TWS, ILLIT, KATSEYE, aoen, CORTIS, and SANTOS BRAVOS on the big screen. Join this unforgettable celebration filled with diverse music, passionate fan energy, and a dazzling wave of Light Sticks!

results.title: SEVENTEEN WORLD TOUR 'NEW_'
results.overview: Celebrating their 10th debut anniversary, SEVENTEEN embarks on a world tour fueled by their determination for a fresh start, just like the title 'NEW_'. With their unrivaled stage presence and explosive energy, SEVENTEEN once again proves their unlimited potential. Experience the blazing heat of the concert—bursting with each member’s unique charm—right on the big screen!

results.title: Weethara is a Goatman
results.original_title: วีธราเป็นมนุษย์แพะ
results.overview: As the demands of working life begin to consume her, Weethara dreams one day that a pair of goat horns has grown from her forehead. The strange memory of encountering the Goatman as a child resurfaces, after being buried for fifteen years.

results.title: 20 Cents
results.original_title: เหรียญสลึง
results.overview: Kluay went to the district office to apply for a deferment of his status as a monkey, but the longer he waited, the more unsure he became about whether it was better to be a monkey or a human.

results.title: In the Trench
results.overview: A soldier lives in a small cloud of fear.

results.title: Vision of a Murder
results.overview: On their last night together two best friends Johnathan and Ricky go out, taping their every experience. However as the footage continues Johnathan starts to see a second personality of the friend he once knew.

results.title: Pretend you're my girlfriend
results.overview: Mark, a young man grieving over his girlfriend’s death, creates an AI persona of her to have closure. However, as the AI persona begins to say things that sound too familiar to him he– slowly realizes he might be speaking to someone from the other side.

results.title: MATE
results.original_title: เพื่อนสัมพันธ์
results.overview: Roommates who are far more than just roommates must confront the unspoken feelings they've kept buried inside.

results.title: Somewhere Over The Rainbow
results.overview: Two completely “normal” friends explore Bangkok in their own peculiar way, navigating its chaotic streets, questionable transportation, and very confusing customs. Along the way, one of them discovers that she’s… hungry. And that she really, really loves food. What begins as a simple mission to find grilled chicken and sato soon turns into an unexpected journey of food, friendship, and questionable life choices.

results.title: When you leave, it will be night
results.overview: Nicolò joins a rehab facility to support his uncle Matteo during his final month there. As they navigate the community's daily routines and their own complex relationship, an unaddressed past guilt resurfaces, forcing them to confront deep family trauma and blurring the line between who is saving whom.

results.title: Ice-Skating  Class
results.original_title: คาบเรียนไอซ์สเก็ต
results.overview: In the heat of Thailand, Mint goes through ordinary childhood days, often compared to her older sister. When her best friend Kao introduces her to ice skating, Mint discovers a new passion and begins to dream of taking classes with her friend. But in a country where winter never comes, her small dream soon encounters the realities of home.

results.title: Love-Ly: Will She Find a Boyfriend in 7 Days?
results.original_title: Love-Ly 7 วันนี้ลี่ต้องมีแฟน
results.overview: After a fortune teller predicts that she will remain single for the rest of her life if she doesn’t find a boyfriend by her 25th birthday, Ly, a young woman who has just been cheated on, has only seven days to find a new one.

results.title: RERUM
results.overview: RERUM depicts a tense state in which creeping subterranean forces deform and consume images and memory. Shots of fiery processes beneath the Earth’s crust alternate with 8mm footage which captures several generations of families in moments of carefree leisure. The anthropocentric world, where the underground is recalled only by fissures, loses its relevance. This fragile equilibrium is inevitably heading toward destruction.
